derivation: passive participle of H5956 (עָלַם) in the denominative sense of H5958 (עֶלֶם);
def: (only in plural as abstract) adolescence; figuratively, vigor

words.word: of the sin of his youth

occurrences.text: His bones are full of the sin of his youth, which shall lie down with him in the dust.
words: of the sin of his youth

occurrences.text: The days of his youth hast thou shortened: thou hast covered him with shame. Selah.

Fear not; for thou shalt not be ashamed: neither be thou confounded; for thou shalt not be put to shame: for thou shalt forget the shame of thy youth, and shalt not remember the reproach of thy widowhood any more.
